hints.title: Row By Row Divisibility Count
hints.text: In the i-th row of the multiplication table, values are multiples of i up to i times n. How many numbers in that single row are less than or equal to a target value x?

hints.title: Clamped Quotient Sum Invariant
hints.text: For row i, the count of values bounded by x is the minimum of n and x divided by i. Summing this term over all rows produces the total count in O(m) time.

hints.title: Table Value Range Bisection Procedure
hints.text: Set the search bounds from one to m times n. For candidate value mid, sum the row-by-row counts min(n, mid divided by i). If the total count is at least k, narrow high to mid; otherwise raise low to mid plus one. Return low.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(M log(M * N)) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Allocating the full m x n multiplication table takes O(m * n) memory and time, which exceeds limits for dimensions up to 30,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting values less than or equal to mid takes O(m) operations per guess, resulting in O(m log(m * n)) total runtime and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should quickly derive the floor division formula min(n, mid / i) and verify that low converges to a table value.
